name: Aurum Academy
source:
Aurum Academy is a gay furry linear visual novel with a single branching point in the narrative, dictating which of several romance paths to follow!

Ever since Kienan came to Aurum City as a child, the violet edifice of education looming over the city sight-line always caught his attention. With the drive to better himself and the will to protect others against the dangers of the outside world, he is finally able to attend the ever prestigious Aurum Academy.
...But it won't be easy! He will have to balance school work, conflicts, rigorous military training, but most importantly... a budding romance between him and one of his peers!?

[From [url=https://ray-draws.itch.io/aurum-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
